status: FROZEN before the formal run (committed before results/formal_v01 was written). Smoke run (4 series, 5 gens) was used for implementation checks only. delta_abs and the noise floor were NOT changed after the smoke run.
role: V/Q-type independent audit. Abstract closed well-mixed network with an EXTERNAL transfer protocol. Not a Genesis Room, not an experiments/eNNN entry, not a 3D emergence Level, not a claim about life.

questions.Q1: Does the parent composition change the child's future composition?
questions.Q2: Is any such effect beyond simple material carryover (dilution of the transferred fraction)?
questions.Q3: NOT_TESTED in v0.1 (evolvability). Requires selectable, accumulating heritable differences; not measured here.

chemistry.justification_g: Declared, symmetric choice. Sets the equilibrium constants K = exp(-Delta_r G0) = e^2 for every reaction and nothing else. Not tuned to any result.
chemistry.reverse_rate_constant: k- = KF / K_r (detailed balance by construction; never randomised)
chemistry.rate_law: mass action, ideal dilute, activity = c / c0
chemistry.free_energy: G = sum_i c_i (g_i + ln c_i - 1); mu_i = g_i + ln c_i

initial_conditions.seeded_state: gen 0 for series s: complex amounts nXY, nXZ, nXYZ ~ Uniform(0, 0.3) from rng(10000 + s); monomers fill the remaining element totals; all counts >= 0
initial_conditions.status: external preparation (declared). Not emerged, not a mutation.

arms.L1: own-parent lineage, transfer fraction f, reactions on
arms.LR: units-only counterfactual: transferred part reconstituted as monomers (identical to L0 at each generation start by construction; check T06)
arms.L0: untransferred control: fresh monomers each generation (f = 0), reactions on
arms.LN: passive: as L1 with reaction constants zero
arms.LS: foreign donor: transfer from L1 end state of series (s + 12) mod 24 in the same generation

integrators.primary: scipy solve_ivp BDF, rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-12, no clipping

statistics.unit: series (24). Generations are reduced to one value per series before any test.
statistics.delta_justification: 1% of the element total T = 1. ODE tolerance errors are below 1e-8 (T14), so the threshold is far above numerical noise; it is a declared minimum effect size.
statistics.delta_noise_floor_justification: Numerical floor: ODE tolerance errors < 1e-8 (T14). Reported as 'detectable above noise' alongside the meaningful threshold delta_abs. Both are declared before the formal run; delta_abs is NOT changed after the smoke run.

metrics.M3_parent_specific_dispersion: per series: distance of the series state to the mean state of all series in the same arm and generation
metrics.M4_shared_offset: per series: distance of L1 to the paired LR at the same generation
metrics.passive_expectation: f^g * mean_s dispersion_s(gen 0), exact for passive carryover (checked by T13)
metrics.R_passive_ratio: mean dispersion at g / passive expectation, paired by series

decision_rules.A_single_generation_carryover_present: lower 95% CI of dispersion at g=1 > delta
decision_rules.C_parent_specific_persistence_present: lower 95% CI of dispersion at g=5 > delta
decision_rules.Q2_excess_over_passive_at_g1: EXCESS if lower 95% CI of R_passive(g=1) > 1; BELOW_PASSIVE if upper < 1; else NOT_DISTINGUISHABLE
decision_rules.shared_offset_at_final_gen_present: lower 95% CI of M4 at final generation > delta
decision_rules.parent_specific_at_final_gen_present: lower 95% CI of M3 at final generation > delta
decision_rules.donor_identity_effect_at_g1_present: lower 95% CI of L1 vs LS distance at g=1 > delta
decision_rules.interpretation_rule: A shared offset with no parent-specific dispersion at the final generation is a property of the single attractor of the protocol and kinetics. It is recorded as NOT parent-specific heredity. A PASS of Q2 never by itself means inheritance.
decision_rules.detectable_above_noise: A_detectable_above_noise_floor / C_detectable_above_noise_floor use lower CI > 1e-6 and are reported as a separate column.

forbidden_by_design: observers that write to the state
freeze_note: Exploratory magnitudes (dispersion ~1e-3 to 1e-2 at tau=2, 0.2) were looked at before this draft; delta_abs = 0.01 was fixed in the draft as a declared minimum effect size. Sensitivity to delta is reported in AUDIT.md as descriptive, not used for verdicts.
